parsed.explanation: The quote appears verbatim as the write-up's own "Remaining crux", and in context it means exactly what the objection says: the finiteness statement (S_infty finitely generated / shrinkage stops) is not proved. Scanning the whole text, nothing establishes any large-prime-erasure or finite-relevant-prime-set lemma for all terms: Theorem A gives only the characterization (C); the gap bound gives a_{n+1}-a_n <= rad(a_1) but no bound on relevant primes; Lemmas A-D describe permanents but never bound their number; the only support for stabilization is explicitly empirical ("Empirics (100+ values of a_1 ...)" and "Proof of that lemma is in progress"). Without a finite generating set there is no finite modulus L, so obligation (F) is unmet and the periodicity assembly (P) is conditional. Hence the objection is correct and load-bearing.
